channel.title: Robert Alter English Bible Readings
channel.description: English readings from Robert Alter's translation of the Hebrew Bible, read by Rabbi Joseph Dweck. Covers the weekly Torah portions (parashiot) from Genesis through Deuteronomy.
channel.itunes:author: Rabbi Joseph Dweck
channel.itunes:summary: English readings from Robert Alter's celebrated translation of the Hebrew Bible, covering the weekly Torah portions (parashiot).
